offers_products.reason: Manufactures single-use medical devices, components, foam and packaging products for medical device makers, plus aerospace, defense and automotive components.

offers_services.reason: Contract design, development and engineering services as a CDMO, though manufacturing is the larger part.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are medical device manufacturers and industrial OEMs; no direct sales to households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Outsource partner to top medical device manufacturers, plus aerospace, defense and automotive companies.

recurring_revenue.reason: Custom components and devices made in repeat production runs for OEM customers' ongoing programs.

cyclical_demand.reason: Mostly single-use medical devices and wound care, infection prevention; demand is fairly steady, though industrial lines are somewhat cyclical.

big_ticket.reason: Components and single-use devices are sold in frequent, small-unit repeat orders.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for manufactured devices, components and packaging, not mainly staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are top global medical device manufacturers and large aerospace, defense and automotive firms.

asset_heavy.reason: Runs multiple manufacturing plants with tooling, cleanroom and molding equipment; needs ongoing capital investment to grow.
